verdict.rationale: gstack ships a top-level routing skill that 'sends any gstack request to the right skill' (planning, review, QA, shipping, and others), and individual SKILL.md files carry trigger phrases such as the QA skill's 'quality check', 'test the app', 'run QA'. Per-site domain skills are also injected automatically into prompt context when a session visits that host. These show context-driven activation, but nothing documents that descriptions are deliberately engineered for accurate auto-activation, or shows hands-on proof that the right skill fires at the right moment. Missing for 10: explicit docs on description/trigger engineering for auto-activation, evidence that triggering is reliable across skills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
